paragraphs.text: Grete is a redhaired cathar apostate who lives on the plane of Innistrad .

As second in command to Commander Odric she was responsible for the transport of the prisoner Gisa Cecani after the Siege of Thraben . After the occurrence Avacyn 's madness , and the Lunarch Council was exposed to be controlled by the Skirsdag , Odric and Grete fled the Church. They joined Thalia as part of the Order of Saint Traft . Grete fought with Thalia in the Battle of Thraben , while joined with a spirit .
